newsitem.title: CROATIA: Bosnian Croats to boycott federal bodies.
newsitem.headline: Bosnian Croats to boycott federal bodies.

text.p: The Bosnian Croat ruling HDZ party instructed its officials in federal bodies on Tuesday to freeze their mandates pending a proper power-sharing agreement with the Moslems, state television reported.
The instruction, dealing another blow to the fragile Bosnian federation created under U.S. pressure in early 1994, was issued after an HDZ assembly held in the southern town of Mostar.

The statement said the next federal president should be a Croat and Croats should also get six ministerial posts, adding they had decided to act to counter "accusations in Moslem media that the HDZ was violating the agreements".
"But we are still ready to negotiate with the SDA (ruling Moslem party)," the statement said.
The federal parliament, due to convene on Wednesday, has been informed Croat deputies will not attend.
The nationalist HDZ controls less than 20 percent of Bosnia comprising the Federation and the Serb republic.
